run_test_replay_buffer: run an online RL test with a replay buffer using a config file and environment
run_test_online_episode: run an online RL test that trains on each episode trajectory end
eval_policy: evaluate a serving policy over N episodes and return the mean reward
test_replay_buffer_gym_cpu: test replay buffer gym algorithms like DQN and SAC on CPU
test_online_episode_gym_cpu: test online episode gym algorithms like REINFORCE and PPO on CPU
